description: Renders the deploy kit for a project from explicit parameters: .github/workflows/deploy-plesk.yml and deploy/plesk/ (build-bundle.sh, the <app>-deploy release manager, deploy.conf.example, server-setup.sh, the database dump helper, PM2 or systemd definitions, optional nginx directives, README.md). A DRY RUN by default: it returns each file’s action and a diff (against the vetted template for a new file, against the current file for an existing one) and writes nothing. With write: true it writes inside the repository root only, never through a symlink, never deletes, and never replaces an existing file unless its path is listed in overwrite. Values it doesn’t know are left as FILL IN and listed. Use it in phase 5, after the user agreed the plan; write only after they saw the diff. Refuses to write a kit that contains anything that looks like a secret.

app.description: The app name used by the release manager (<app>-deploy, /etc/<app>/)

app_group.description: A Linux user or group name

app_user.description: The account that runs the app, from the server. Left as FILL IN if unknown

base_dir.description: BASE on the server: where releases/, current and shared/ live

build_time_vars.description: Public build-time values (repository variables), names only

items.description: An environment variable name (never its value)

checkout_env.description: The env file inside the folder production runs from today

checkout_uploads.description: Run-time files inside the folder production runs from today

ci_workflow.description: The existing CI workflow the deploy calls for its tests

database.description: Adds the pre-migration dump for this engine

deploy_user.description: The SSH account GitHub Actions uses (default <app>-deploy)

env_file.description: The app's env file on the server (default /etc/<app>/app.env)

health_checks.description: What the release manager checks after the switch; prefer the app’s own port, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3001/health

contains.description: Text the response must contain, e.g. "status":"ready"

health_commit_url.description: A URL whose answer must contain the release’s commit

migrate_cmd.description: A shell command written into deploy.conf (this server never runs it)

nginx.description: Only if the proxy needs changing; a working proxy is left alone

node_bin_dir.description: The folder with the node (and pm2) the app uses, e.g. /opt/plesk/node/24/bin

not_deployed_paths.description: Path prefixes whose changes are tested but not deployed (.md files never deploy)

overwrite.description: Existing files that may be replaced. List one only after showing the user what is there and getting agreement

php_fpm_service.description: The domain's FPM service, e.g. plesk-php83-fpm

pm2_apps.description: Each PM2 process: its name, its folder in the release, its script, and arguments

pm2_home.description: An absolute path on the server

post_switch_cmd.description: A shell command written into deploy.conf (this server never runs it)

process_manager.description: What the server reloads after the switch; keep what runs today

project_dir.description: Absolute path of the repository root. Defaults to the open project in Claude Code.

public_health_url.description: A public URL whose answer contains the deployed commit (a health endpoint or version.json)

runtime_env_names.description: Names for the placeholder env file server-setup.sh creates, never values

items.description: An environment variable name (never its value)

target.description: An absolute path on the server

site_url.description: The public site, checked from outside after each deploy

stack.description: Which build-bundle.sh branch builds the release

static_dir.description: Static sites: the build output folder (default dist)

name.description: A systemd unit name, e.g. myapp-api or plesk-php83-fpm

write.description: false (default): return the plan and diffs, write nothing

name: generate_deploy_kit
title: Generate the deploy kit
